FEAT-001.evidence: E2E branch commit 10ce6e10 replaced asyncio.create_subprocess_shell with asyncio.create_subprocess_exec to prevent shell injection. Added validate_argv() rejecting 23 shell metacharacters (|, &, ;, $, `, \, <, >, etc.) and validate_executable() enforcing ALLOWED_COMMANDS allowlist. Canonical-wiring does NOT have this fix - the migration_repair directory does not exist in canonical-wiring.
FEAT-001.security_impact: HIGH - Prevents arbitrary command execution via shell metacharacter injection

FEAT-002.evidence: E2E branch commit f6622f0e added TRUSTED_TEST_HOSTS allowlist (localhost, 127.0.0.1, test-postgres) and TRUSTED_TEST_DATABASES allowlist. Implemented validate_and_connect() with defense-in-depth: validates host AND database name against allowlists, parses PostgreSQL URLs, validates credentials isolation. Documented that name pattern checking alone is insufficient. Canonical-wiring does NOT have this fix.
FEAT-002.security_impact: HIGH - Prevents accidental production database writes during VERIFY mode operations
FEAT-002.test_coverage: 17 tests covering validation scenarios - all passing

FEAT-003.evidence: E2E branch commit 6bdc3389 wrapped run_verification_pipeline() in try/finally block ensuring cleanup always runs. Added ensure_cleanup() that runs V10 teardown, added verify_database_dropped() checking docker-compose ps output, logs cleanup to .agents/evidence/runs/cleanup-{timestamp}.jsonl, marks stage BLOCKED if cleanup fails. Canonical-wiring does NOT have this fix.
FEAT-003.security_impact: MEDIUM - Prevents resource leaks and ensures test database containers are properly torn down
FEAT-003.test_coverage: 8 tests covering cleanup guarantee - all passing

FEAT-004.evidence: E2E branch commit 9bce2b68 added three verification functions: verify_evidence_files() (checks existence AND recomputes SHA-256 hashes), verify_test_coverage() (rejects SKIPPED status for required tests), verify_commit_identity() (compares git SHA with tested SHA). Returns BLOCKED with detailed errors if evidence missing/tampered, tests skipped, or SHA mismatch. Canonical-wiring does NOT have this fix.
FEAT-004.security_impact: HIGH - Prevents approval based on fabricated or tampered test evidence
FEAT-004.test_coverage: 12 tests in test_final_gate_verification.py, 15 existing gate tests - all passing

FEAT-005.evidence: E2E branch commit 26e2413a added PublicationState tracking approval/local commit/push/remote verification. Implemented fetch_remote_sha() parsing git ls-remote output, comparing local vs remote SHA after push. Returns FAILED if SHA mismatch detected. Records full publication.json to .agents/evidence/runs/. Canonical-wiring does NOT have this fix.
FEAT-005.security_impact: MEDIUM - Confirms published code matches approved/tested code, prevents silent publication failures
FEAT-005.test_coverage: 11 tests covering all publication scenarios - all passing
